components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Ink filled editorial action with rust hover.
components.css: .ds-button-solid { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:30px; min-height:49px; padding:0 23px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:var(--foreground, #24251f); color:var(--background, #f5f1e9); font:700 11px/1.2 'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s,color .25s,transform .25s; }.ds-button-solid:hover { background:var(--accent, #9f3b30); color:#fff; transform:translateY(-2px); }.ds-button-solid:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #9f3b30); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action with an ink reversal on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:30px; min-height:49px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid var(--foreground, #24251f); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground, #24251f); font:700 11px/1.2 'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s,color .25s; }.ds-button-outline:hover { background:var(--foreground, #24251f); color:var(--background, #f5f1e9); }.ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #9f3b30); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Studio Input
components.html: <input class="ds-studio-input" type="text" placeholder="Nhập yêu cầu của bạn..." aria-label="Yêu cầu phối đồ" />
components.css: .ds-studio-input { width:100%; max-width:320px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--border, #d8d0c1); border-radius:0; background:#fff; color:var(--foreground, #24251f); font:400 14px/1.4 'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; caret-color:var(--accent, #9f3b30); }.ds-studio-input:hover { border-color:var(--text-secondary, #625f56); }.ds-studio-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--accent, #9f3b30); outline:2px solid var(--accent, #9f3b30); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Prompt Chip
components.description: Pill shaped example question in the studio chat.
components.css: .ds-prompt-chip { padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid var(--border, #d8d0c1); border-radius:9999px; background:#fff; color:var(--text-secondary, #625f56); font:400 12px/1.3 'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:color .2s,border-color .2s; }.ds-prompt-chip:hover { color:var(--accent, #9f3b30); border-color:var(--accent, #9f3b30); }.ds-prompt-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #9f3b30); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Garment Card
components.description: Image first garment tile with a quiet editorial caption.
components.css: .ds-garment-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; width:220px; padding:0; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--border, #d8d0c1); border-radius:0; background:var(--surface, #fffdf8); color:var(--foreground, #24251f); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s; }.ds-garment-card:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); border-color:var(--accent, #9f3b30); box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(28,31,25,.08); }.ds-garment-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #9f3b30); outline-offset:3px; }.ds-garment-art { position:relative; display:grid; place-items:center; height:160px; background:var(--surface-subtle, #eee9df); }.ds-garment-line { font:italic 64px/1 'Cormorant Garamond',Cambria,Georgia,serif; color:var(--text-secondary, #625f56); }.ds-garment-category { position:absolute; top:12px; left:12px; padding:5px 8px; border:1px solid var(--border, #d8d0c1); background:var(--surface, #fffdf8); color:var(--accent, #9f3b30); font:700 9px/1 'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; }.ds-garment-details { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; padding:17px 17px 20px; border-top:1px solid var(--border, #d8d0c1); }.ds-garment-details strong { font:600 16px/1.35 Cambria,Georgia,serif; }.ds-garment-details>span { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; color:var(--text-secondary, #625f56); font:400 11px/1.3 'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; }.ds-garment-details em { color:var(--accent, #9f3b30); font-style:normal; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: Small editorial route links with a rust active underline.
components.html: Tủ đồAI StylistStudioĐặt thuê
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, #d8d0c1); }.ds-nav a { padding:20px 0 18px; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; color:var(--text-secondary, #625f56); font:600 12px/1.2 'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; transition:color .2s,border-color .2s; }.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a.ds-nav-active { color:var(--foreground, #24251f); border-color:var(--accent, #9f3b30); }.ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #9f3b30); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
VietDrobe presents Vietnamese traditional dress as something to explore, combine, and wear today. The interface uses the quiet structure of an editorial page: warm paper, deep ink, fine borders, open space, and expressive serif headings. Rust marks an action or selected state; olive supports the garment illustration and the darker atmosphere.

The catalog and rental path carry the same visual weight as guided styling. The studio has a working, three part composition, with chat given the widest default column. Garment illustrations and cultural context are the visual subject; the app does not use AI generated imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and ink in light mode; olive tinted dark surfaces in dark mode.
Self hosted Cormorant Garamond display type with a plain sans serif interface.
Square panels, fine borders, and selective rust emphasis.
Two equally visible journeys from the home page: browsing garments and AI styling.

rules.name: The Rust Signal Rule
rules.body: Use rust for purposeful emphasis such as selection, focus, and action feedback, rather than broad surface fills.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the display serif for identity and editorial hierarchy; use the sans serif for navigation, controls, and compact metadata.

rules.name: The Equal Entry Rule
rules.body: Home page routes to garment browsing and guided styling are parallel choices, neither hidden behind the other.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep resting cards and studio panels border led; reserve lift for hover or overlay hierarchy.

dos: Do keep browse and rent, and AI styling, equally easy to enter.
Do use supplied garment artwork and show garment identity and cultural context clearly.
Do pair rust emphasis with visible text or border changes so states remain legible in both themes.
Do preserve the chat first stack and its roomy desktop column in the studio.
donts: Don't introduce AI generated images into the app.
Don't round ordinary cards, panels, buttons, or fields.
Don't use heavy resting shadows where a paper tone and thin border carry the separation.
